title: Maximum Path Intersection Sum in a Grid
summary: Choose one right/down path from the top-left to bottom-right of a grid and another right/up path from bottom-left to top-right. Score the sum of values in cells shared by both paths, counting each shared cell once. Maximize this sum and return it; values may be negative.
officialConstraints: 2..1000 rows and columns; total cells 4..500000; cell values -100..100.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
